?: The Qt tool's '?' and 'Guide' toolbar buttons. The emtk app has a 'Help' button (same help.md) next to 'Guide'.

inferno: Colormap entry; offered by the canvas once an image exists (populated state).
magma: Colormap entry; offered by the canvas once an image exists (populated state).
viridis: Colormap entry; offered by the canvas once an image exists (populated state).
gray: Colormap entry; offered by the canvas once an image exists (populated state).
cividis: Not ported: the shared ImageCanvas offers magma, inferno, viridis and gray only.
plasma: Not ported: the shared ImageCanvas offers magma, inferno, viridis and gray only.
turbo: Not ported: the shared ImageCanvas offers magma, inferno, viridis and gray only.
blur: Internals of the pyqtgraph ImageView inside the Qt image widget (normalisation panel: Operation, Mean, Blur, Subtract, Divide, Off); hidden for the 2-D intensity image. Not ported; the canvas has gamma and display levels instead.
operation: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation panel (see 'blur'); hidden for a 2-D image; not ported.
mean: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation panel (see 'blur'); not ported.
divide: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation panel (see 'blur'); not ported.
subtract: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation panel (see 'blur'); not ported.
off: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation panel (see 'blur'); not ported.
t: pyqtgraph ImageView time axis label; the region image has no time axis; not ported.
x: pyqtgraph ImageView axis label; the canvas draws its own x [px] axis label.
y: pyqtgraph ImageView axis label; the canvas draws its own y [px] axis label.
timerange: pyqtgraph ImageView time-range button; the region image is one summed frame; not ported.
frame: pyqtgraph ImageView frame button; the region image is one summed frame; not ported.
menu: pyqtgraph ImageView menu button; not ported.
roi: pyqtgraph ImageView's own ROI button; the analysis region is edited through the Analysis region section instead.
